Best regards...♩

Dear Babi Nishimura @ Request Accepted
Nice to meet you, my name is Seikomugi, and I am a Vtuber. Thank you for your appeal the other day.
I would very much like to request an illustration to be used in my activities, so I sent you a request.
Here are the details

─────────────────────
Purpose of use
　For use in SNS posts, icons, and thumbnails. (We will not use the image for any use that directly generates revenue, such as merchandise.)
　If your work can be made into merchandise, we would appreciate it if you could add a file or layer stating so. (If there is no mention of this, we will not use it for merchandise.)
Body size
　Please use a body size that is easy to draw.
Composition
　We would appreciate it if you could add either SD or life-size figure, but please make sure that the face area is as close to the figure as possible. We will leave other details such as poses and situations up to you.
Costume
　No specification. You can use an existing costume or a creative one.
Background
　No need to specify.
Delivery format
　We would appreciate it if you could include a transparent version of the background.
Reference
　The chest is modest, and there are no human ears (only mouse ears). (Only mouse ears have grown out.)
https://x.com/sumikko_mugi/status/1499756177139245056?s=46&t=Dk8jTIKH0hPyQQtsQh_t4Q
─────────────────────

I would love to commission this if the above conditions are acceptable. Basically, I would like to leave it up to you, and I would appreciate it if you could draw it freely.
Thank you very much in advance.

Seiko-Mugi

Would love to commission art of my villainess vtuber, Monarch, in a cute summer outfit! Pose and outfit are up to you! She is an elegant queen-type but also has a cute side, so feel free to pose her however you’d like! Can be cute or sexy

Nice to meet you and thank you for this very thoughtful appeal. I apologize for the delay in responding to you.
I would very much like to request an illustration of my favorite Vtuber, Akua Mizuki (@mzsr_akua). I am sorry that this is different from what you suggested, but Babi Nishimura is good at making dreamy illustrations, and I would like to request Akua-san to wear a dreamy outfit. Please excuse the bullet points below.

Facial features and hairstyle: Please refer to the reference images (1), (2) (old model) and (3) (current model) at the URL below. There are several hairstyles available, but please have long hair as shown on the right in (1) and (3).
Clothing...We have an image of something like the one in the reference image (4), but we are not very familiar with that kind of costume, so we would appreciate it if you could draw it as you like, Babi Nishimura.
Pose/expression...I will leave it to you to draw what you are comfortable with, but if possible, I would appreciate a slightly sickly expression with her hand on her cheek.
Background/composition: I will leave it to you to draw what you are comfortable with.
Breasts...Please keep them as modest as possible.
Differences...If possible, I would appreciate it if you could give me differences in hair color and eye color (bright red for the eyes and hair mesh, and bright white for the non-mesh parts of the hair). If this is too much for your budget, you can ignore this item.
Usage...tweets with your name, ID, and FA tag "Nyahiart" (may be used as a thumbnail, etc.).

Reference image ①...https://imgur.com/a/45vvhdd
Reference image②...https://imgur.com/a/fZJuysg
Reference image (3)...https://imgur.com/a/UH9r1ca
Reference image④...https://imgur.com/a/JDvmF1k

We apologize for the length of this article.
We hope you will consider our proposal.

Nice to meet you!
My name is Peri Indigo and I am an individual Vtuber.
I would like to send you a request to draw an illustration.

Character reference: https://i.ibb.co/M8m8mQY/553095-1-output.png
Design details: https://i.ibb.co/m6Vvk6d/ref-sheet-2.png

Illustration: I would like to ask you to draw an illustration for me.
I would like to draw both eyes, or a rose above the eyes, as you prefer. She has a birthmark under her purple eye (below the rose).
However, if you can draw both eyes and include the rose as a separate layer of the PSD, we would greatly appreciate it. However, you do not have to do so...!
You can draw her original hairstyle, ponytail, etc. as you wish.
You can choose to follow the references or draw any clothes you like.
There is no set pose or composition, you can do whatever you like.

[Mascot
https://i.ibb.co/hMhFMry/758662-4-merged.png
The mascot is optional and does not have to be included in the illustration. If you do not want to draw it, or if it does not fit the image of the picture, it is totally fine not to force it.

Usage
We would like to use it for general promotions and distribution thumbnails for our usual activities including SNS.
We may use them for event announcements and other promotional activities.
We may request to use your work for a stream, a part of a music video, or an animation to be introduced on SNS.

Other.
We would appreciate it if you could provide us with psd data for each layer, separating the transparent version of the person and the background.
If the artist does not wish to provide psd's, we expect that we may be able to provide the character on a transparent background, and the background and other effects as separate images.
∙ We will always credit you as the illustrator when the illustration is used.

Thank you very much for your consideration of the above.
Thank you !!! 🙇‍

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Z0w1T0HngVwHSfPNbmCwXRMM4CESrpu4?usp=share_link
